citizenEntry.title: How would you like to report?
citizenEntry.intro: Choose the reporting path that feels right for you. You can continue without sharing identity details.
citizenEntry.noticeCopy: This is a prototype service. It does not connect to government identity systems or use real OTP verification.
citizenEntry.anonymousCopy: Start your report without an account or identity fields.
citizenEntry.anonymousPointOne: No name, email, phone, or account is collected.
citizenEntry.anonymousPointTwo: Your report remains separate from any signed-in user.
citizenEntry.identifiedCopy: Verify a synthetic demo identity to save and continue your report.
citizenEntry.identifiedPointOne: Only the supplied synthetic demo identities are accepted.
citizenEntry.identifiedPointTwo: No real Aadhaar, government ID, mobile OTP, or live verification is used.
citizenEntry.mockCopy: Use a safe test email and a non-sensitive password. Do not enter Aadhaar, PAN, OTP, or payment details.
citizenEntry.profileError: We could not save your prototype profile. Check the service and try again.
citizenEntry.identifiedReadyCopy: Your prototype profile is saved. Continue to incident details in the next reporting step.
citizenEntry.anonymousReadyCopy: No identity information was collected. Continue to incident details in the next reporting step.
citizenEntry.stepOneCopy: Describe what happened and choose a report category.
citizenEntry.stepTwoCopy: Add people involved and any available evidence.
citizenEntry.stepThreeCopy: Review the report before creating a reference number.
citizenEntry.nextCopy: Start your incident details and save a draft before adding people or evidence.
citizenEntry.identityIntro: Use one of the supplied synthetic demo identity records. No government system, real identity data, or SMS delivery is used.
citizenEntry.mockIdentityCopy: This local prototype only checks synthetic records stored for the demo. The linked mobile is shown only in masked form and no message is sent.
citizenEntry.identityInputHelp: Enter the 14-digit synthetic identity number from DEMO-CREDENTIALS.md.
citizenEntry.identityRequestError: We could not verify that synthetic identity. Check the number in DEMO-CREDENTIALS.md and try again.
citizenEntry.otpIssuedCopy: A local-only demo OTP is now active for {mobile}. No SMS or external service was used.
citizenEntry.identityVerifyError: The demo OTP could not be verified. Request a new OTP or check the supplied credentials.
citizenEntry.profileLoadingCopy: Please wait while the local profile details are loaded.
citizenEntry.profileReviewCopy: Your name and registered mobile came from the synthetic demo identity and remain locked. You can update the other profile details before continuing.
citizenEntry.profileVerifiedCopy: This profile is sourced from local demonstration data. It has no connection to Aadhaar, UIDAI, mobile carriers, or government systems.
citizenEntry.dashboardSafetyCopy: Report cyber harm and keep every complaint in one secure place.
citizenEntry.dashboardCopy: Manage your profile, reports, and complaint tracking.
citizenEntry.dashboardProfileCopy: Review the verified details linked to your prototype identity.
citizenEntry.dashboardReportCopy: Start a cybercrime report and attach supporting evidence.
citizenEntry.dashboardReportsCopy: Continue drafts and review all submitted complaints.
citizenEntry.dashboardTrackCopy: Check all four complaint progress stages using a reference number.
citizenEntry.dashboardSecurityTitle: Your information is safe with us
citizenEntry.dashboardSecurityCopy: Prototype profile and complaint data remain protected by server-side ownership rules.

complaintDraft.incidentIntro: Save the key incident details first. You can then add people involved and optional evidence before review.
complaintDraft.peopleIntro: Add any information that may help explain who was involved. Leave fields blank when details are unavailable.
complaintDraft.loadingCopy: Please wait while the reporting form is prepared.
complaintDraft.categoriesError: Complaint categories could not be loaded. Please try again.
complaintDraft.draftUnavailable: This draft is unavailable in the current reporting session.
complaintDraft.descriptionHelp: Include the platform or medium used, relevant actions, and any information that may help the report.
complaintDraft.saved: Your incident details are saved. You can add evidence here or continue to people involved.
complaintDraft.evidenceAfterSave: Save the incident draft before attaching any evidence. Evidence files are stored through the protected upload service; only metadata is kept in the database.
complaintDraft.evidenceDescription: Upload only material that you are permitted to share. Do not upload passwords, OTPs, Aadhaar, PAN, payment secrets, or other unnecessary private information.
complaintDraft.evidenceSize: Supported file types: PDF, PNG, JPG, JPEG. File limits are checked by the server.
complaintDraft.evidenceError: The evidence file could not be uploaded. Check the file and try again.
complaintDraft.peopleSavedCopy: This draft is ready for the review and submission step in the next session.
complaintDraft.saveError: We could not save this draft. Check the service and try again.

validation.title: Enter a title with at least 3 characters.
validation.description: Describe the incident in at least 10 characters.
validation.futureIncident: The incident date and time cannot be in the future.

complaintDraft.evidenceSaveCopy: Your selected file uploads securely when you save this incident draft.
complaintDraft.affectedTitle: Who is affected by this incident?
complaintDraft.affectedLegend: Choose the option that best describes the primary affected person.
complaintDraft.affectedSelfCopy: I am directly affected by this incident.
complaintDraft.affectedChildCopy: I am reporting for a child under my care.
complaintDraft.affectedOtherCopy: I am reporting for another person.
complaintDraft.affectedNameRequired: Enter the affected person name before continuing.
complaintDraft.suspectQuestionTitle: Do you know anything about the suspect?
complaintDraft.suspectQuestionCopy: Share any available details. You can continue even when the suspect is unknown.
complaintDraft.suspectNo: No, I do not have information
complaintDraft.noSuspectCopy: Continue without guessing. You can report only what you know.

complaintCompletion.title: Review and submit your complaint
complaintCompletion.intro: Check the saved details carefully. You can return to any section to make changes before submission.
complaintCompletion.loadingCopy: Please wait while the saved report is prepared.
complaintCompletion.draftUnavailable: This draft is unavailable in the current reporting session.
complaintCompletion.declarationLabel: I confirm that the information in this complaint is accurate to the best of my knowledge.
complaintCompletion.declarationCopy: This safe prototype does not send information to government systems. Do not include passwords, OTPs, Aadhaar, PAN, payment secrets, or unnecessary personal information.
complaintCompletion.declarationRequired: Confirm the declaration before submitting the complaint.
complaintCompletion.submitError: The complaint could not be submitted. Please try again.
complaintCompletion.referenceCopy: Use it to check the complaint status without sharing identity details.
complaintCompletion.whatNextCopy: Status updates in this prototype are synthetic and do not represent a government or authority response.
complaintCompletion.trackIntro: Enter the reference number issued when the complaint was submitted.
complaintCompletion.trackingLoadingCopy: Please wait while the complaint status is retrieved.
complaintCompletion.trackingErrorCopy: Check the reference number and try again. Draft complaints cannot be tracked.
complaintCompletion.prototypeUpdateCopy: Updates are synthetic demonstration data. This service is not connected to authorities or live government systems.
complaintCompletion.anonymousReportsCopy: Anonymous reports are not attached to an account. Use the reference number from submission to view their status.
complaintCompletion.myReportsLoadingCopy: Please wait while your complaint list is retrieved.
complaintCompletion.myReportsErrorTitle: Your reports could not be loaded
complaintCompletion.myReportsErrorCopy: Check the service and try again.
complaintCompletion.noDrafts: You have no saved complaint drafts.
complaintCompletion.noSubmitted: You have no submitted complaints yet.

timelineStageCopy.underReview: The complaint is queued for review.
timelineStageCopy.resolution: The final action appears when available.

suspectReport.title: Report a suspicious identifier
suspectReport.intro: Share information about an identifier you believe may be connected to suspicious online activity. This report does not determine that a person or service has committed a crime.
suspectReport.loadingCopy: Please wait while the safe prototype session is checked.
suspectReport.profileRequiredCopy: Reported identifier records and their evidence are protected by account ownership. Create a safe prototype profile before submitting a report.
suspectReport.checkCopy: This prototype accepts reports but does not expose a public list of submitted identifiers or make verification decisions.
suspectReport.identifierValueHelp: Enter only the suspicious identifier. Never enter passwords, OTPs, PINs, CVV values, or payment secrets.
suspectReport.descriptionHelp: Describe the observed activity without claiming that someone is a confirmed criminal. Avoid unnecessary personal information.
suspectReport.evidenceHelp: Upload only material you are permitted to share. Files are validated and only their metadata is stored in the database.
suspectReport.evidenceSize: Supported file types: PDF, PNG, JPG, JPEG. File limits are checked by the server.
suspectReport.errorTitle: The report could not be submitted
suspectReport.submitError: Check the details and try again.
suspectReport.evidenceError: The identifier report was submitted, but the evidence file could not be uploaded. You can retry the file upload.
suspectReport.submittedCopy: The identifier is recorded as a submitted report. It has not been publicly verified or labelled as criminal activity.

validation.phone: Enter a valid phone number with 8 to 15 digits.
validation.upi: Enter a valid UPI ID, for example sample@upi.
validation.website: Enter a full website URL starting with http:// or https://.

warriorOnboarding.landingSubtitle: Help make India's digital space safer.
warriorOnboarding.landingCopy: Cyber Warriors are citizen volunteers who identify and report suspicious online activity. You provide useful information; authorized teams handle review and action.
warriorOnboarding.applyAction: Apply to become a Cyber Warrior
warriorOnboarding.heroImageAlt: Cyber safety volunteers reviewing suspicious online activity together
warriorOnboarding.volunteerOnlyCopy: Report observations without investigating or confronting anyone.
warriorOnboarding.dutiesTitle: What does a Cyber Warrior do?
warriorOnboarding.dutiesCopy: You find. You report. Authorized teams review and respond.
warriorOnboarding.duty1Copy: Notice suspicious or harmful activity while using digital services.
warriorOnboarding.duty2Copy: Share accurate details through a simple, secure reporting flow.
warriorOnboarding.duty3Copy: Authorized reviewers assess the information you provide.
warriorOnboarding.duty4Copy: Any response or legal action remains with authorized institutions.
warriorOnboarding.duty5Copy: Earn prototype points and badges for responsible contributions.
warriorOnboarding.importantCopy: Cyber Warriors do not investigate, determine guilt, or take legal action. Report only what you genuinely observe.
warriorOnboarding.verifyIntro: Verify one supplied synthetic identity to begin your Cyber Warrior application.
warriorOnboarding.identityHelp: Use a synthetic number from DEMO-CREDENTIALS.md. Never enter a real identity number.
warriorOnboarding.syntheticNotice: Verification stays inside this prototype. No government identity service or real SMS provider is contacted.
warriorOnboarding.requestOtp: Verify identity and request demo OTP
warriorOnboarding.identityRequestError: That synthetic identity could not be verified. Check DEMO-CREDENTIALS.md and try again.
warriorOnboarding.otpCopy: A local demo OTP is active for {mobile}. No SMS was sent.
warriorOnboarding.identityVerifyError: The demo OTP could not be verified. Request a fresh OTP or check the credential file.
warriorOnboarding.secureCopy: Synthetic verification is used only to create a local application profile and prevent accidental use of real personal data.
warriorOnboarding.privacyCopy: Your demo identity is never sent to a government system or mobile carrier.
warriorOnboarding.profileLoadingCopy: Preparing the synthetic identity details for review.
warriorOnboarding.profileSetupCopy: Review the verified details and complete your application profile.
warriorOnboarding.lockedFieldsCopy: Verified name, date of birth, and registered mobile remain locked.
warriorOnboarding.profileDetailsCopy: Core details are auto-filled. Complete the remaining preferences before continuing.
warriorOnboarding.autofillCopy: These local demonstration details have been auto-filled for review.
warriorOnboarding.profileSaveError: The Cyber Warrior profile could not be saved. Please try again.
warriorOnboarding.applicationReadyCopy: Identity and eligibility setup is complete. Your application can now continue to resume upload.
warriorOnboarding.resumeNextCopy: The upload, extraction, review, and submission flow begins in the next application step.
